webster.text: Habitually idle or indisposed to labor; lazy; listless; sluggish; indulging in ease; applied to persons.

example.quote: As to the indolent and fraudulent, nothing will reclaim these but the hand of force and compulsion.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
